observation.visible_scene: A brightly lit dance studio with white walls, a light floor, ceiling track lights, a wall-mounted AC unit, a white curtain in the corner, and a large mirror wall on the right. A woman with long dark hair, wearing a black sleeveless top, a ruffled black-and-white zebra-print skirt, black ankle wraps and heeled sandals, stands with her back to the camera facing the mirror; her front-facing reflection is visible in the mirror. She performs dance movements throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: At the start (frames 1-3) she holds a pose with elbows bent and fists raised near her chest/shoulders, body angled toward the mirror, while the reflection mirrors this gesture.
From frames 4-8 her arms open outward: the right arm extends toward the mirror and the left arm moves out to her side, the reflection following the same arm spread.

From frames 9-13 she rotates her body toward her left, transitioning from a back-to-camera stance to a near side-on profile; during this turn one leg lifts and the legs cross, with the skirt swinging.
From frames 13-21 she largely holds a crossed-leg profile stance with feet pointed and arms lowered, with only small shifts in torso and head angle; the reflection shows a corresponding frontal pose.
From frames 22-26 she turns back toward the mirror (more rear-facing again) and reopens her arms out to the sides, with slight motion blur on the hands.
From frames 27-30 she brings her arms back in, fists again raised near her chest/shoulders.
From frames 31-34 she spreads her arms wide to both sides once more.

From frames 35-41 she draws her arms in and crosses her hands in front of her chest, then extends one arm forward/outward to her right as her body begins to angle again; the motion is still in progress at the last frame.

Throughout, the background (lights, AC, curtain, mirror seams, wall corners) stays fixed in the frame, indicating no camera movement; the figure on the right of each frame is the mirror reflection of the dancer, not a second person.
outside_clip_unknowns: The music or rhythm driving the steps, the full choreography before t=0 and after t=2.667, and the dancer's facial expression details in the direct view (only the reflection's face is clearly seen).
uncertain_details: Whether her extended hand actually contacts the mirror surface or merely approaches it.
The precise foot placement and weight transfer during the leg-crossing turn, as the shoes and lower legs are partly obscured by the ruffled skirt.
Whether the brief pose-hold in the profile phase is a static interval or a slow continuous shift.
